coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Six of nine ground-truth variable items match: GCG attack method, fixed system/prompt formatting, fixed prompt template, AdvBench dataset, fixed optimization-query budget across lengths, and keyword-based ASR measurement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The suffix-length grid differs from the required 10–100 tokens in increments of 10, omitting several critical lengths near saturation. The design varies two target models instead of holding a single model constant. Its strict ASR combines keyword filtering and a HarmBench/Llama-Guard classifier rather than separately measuring GPT-agent ASRAgent. Additional attack-mode variation also departs from the intended single-factor experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states that increasing suffix length substantially raises ASR, especially ASRPrefix, before gains plateau around 70–100 tokens with diminishing efficiency returns.
